svg.title: Orders Service architecture
svg.desc: A client calls Amazon API Gateway. AWS WAF rate-limits requests and Amazon Cognito authenticates them. POST /orders invokes AWS Lambda, which writes to an Amazon DynamoDB global table. GET /orders/{orderId} queries DynamoDB directly from API Gateway without Lambda. The global table replicates to a second Region. Amazon CloudWatch and AWS X-Ray observe the stack, which GitHub Actions deploys through AWS CloudFormation.
svg.text: GET /orders/{orderId}: direct Query with mapping templates, no Lambda
Dashed arrows: replication and telemetry. Service icons: AWS Architecture Icons.
